guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build failed with error code 137 during the step installing system packages (apt-get install -y git python3.8 python3.8-venv python3-pip curl locales locales-all tzdata). The error code 137 typically indicates the process was killed due to out-of-memory (OOM) or exceeding system resources during the package installation step. The full error snippet is: 'The command '/bin/sh -c apt-get update && apt-get install -y Git python3.8 python3.8-venv python3-pip curl locales locales-all tzdata && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*' returned a non-zero code: 137'. This suggests the container environment might not have enough memory allocated to complete these installations. To fix this, try the following: 1) Increase the memory allocated to Docker during the build process. 2) Split the RUN instruction into smaller steps to reduce peak memory usage. For example, install fewer packages at a time or install python3.8 and venv separately. 3) Consider using a lighter base image or a Python official image pre-installed with needed dependencies to reduce build complexity. Make sure no tests are run during Dockerfile build steps as per best practices.
